title: back rest
text: back rest. I purchased two of these, one for myself and one for the guest room.  They come compacted, so they need about 24 hours to "fluff" back out.  You can pop into the dryer for a bit faster fluff.  I was hoping for a firmer, more comfortable back rest.  These are pretty good.  They are stuffed with memory foam chunks.  They do compact as you're using - but mostly firm.  The material is a little velvety and soft..  a medium gray in color.  There is a hand/carry handle on the top of the pillow for easy moving. There is a side pocket - I suppose you could put your remote or cell phone in it? I don't really use it.  I like it - however, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

Featuring anti-clump shredded foam padding for a lifetime of soft comfort-ability. The attached fabric handle makes it easy to carry your pillow with you from room to room.
